analyse.summary: The console rail: destinations, the start card and the decision row.

requirements.text: The rail lists every workspace destination
acceptance: The rail renders eleven buttons, each carrying its own hook: nav-board, nav-runs, nav-inbox, nav-knowledge, nav-workflows, nav-approvals, nav-chat, nav-observability, nav-docs, nav-settings and nav-account. Every button shows a visible label next to its icon.

requirements.text: Selecting Approvals opens the approvals panel
acceptance: After the click, [data-qa="nav-approvals"] carries the class active, and the panel area shows the approvals list under the heading Approvals. The other rail buttons no longer carry active.

requirements.text: An empty start card names the missing fields and disables Start
acceptance: With both required fields empty, [data-qa="start-missing"] reads Needs: Story key, Feature or flow and [data-qa="start-confirm"] is disabled.

requirements.text: Filling the required start fields enables Start
acceptance: Once both required fields hold a value, no element matches [data-qa="start-missing"] and [data-qa="start-confirm"] is enabled and reads Start run.

requirements.text: Dismiss closes the start card without starting a run
acceptance: Clicking [data-qa="start-dismiss"] removes the card: no element matches [data-qa="start-card"], and [data-qa="nav-runs"] lists the same number of runs as it did before the click.

requirements.text: The first checkpoint disables Back and offers Proceed
acceptance: At the first checkpoint [data-qa="decision-back"] is disabled, [data-qa="decision-proceed"] is enabled with the step's proceed label, and [data-qa="decision-edit"], [data-qa="decision-regenerate"] and [data-qa="decision-abort"] are present in the decision row.

acceptance: The rail renders eleven buttons, each carrying its own hook: nav-board, nav-runs, nav-inbox, nav-knowledge, nav-workflows, nav-approvals, nav-chat, nav-observability, nav-docs, nav-settings and nav-account. Every button shows a visible label next to its icon.

requirements.text: Selecting Approvals opens the approvals panel
acceptance: After the click, [data-qa="nav-approvals"] carries the class active, and the panel area shows the approvals list under the heading Approvals. The other rail buttons no longer carry active.

requirements.text: An empty start card names the missing fields and disables Start
acceptance: With both required fields empty, [data-qa="start-missing"] reads Needs: Story key, Feature or flow and [data-qa="start-confirm"] is disabled.

requirements.text: Filling the required start fields enables Start

requirements.text: Dismiss closes the start card without starting a run
acceptance: Clicking [data-qa="start-dismiss"] removes the card: no element matches [data-qa="start-card"], and [data-qa="nav-runs"] lists the same number of runs as it did before the click.

requirements.text: The first checkpoint disables Back and offers Proceed

acceptance: The rail renders eleven buttons, each carrying its own hook: nav-board, nav-runs, nav-inbox, nav-knowledge, nav-workflows, nav-approvals, nav-chat, nav-observability, nav-docs, nav-settings and nav-account. Every button shows a visible label next to its icon.

requirements.text: Selecting Approvals opens the approvals panel
acceptance: After the click, [data-qa="nav-approvals"] carries the class active, and the panel area shows the approvals list under the heading Approvals. The other rail buttons no longer carry active.

requirements.text: An empty start card names the missing fields and disables Start
acceptance: With both required fields empty, [data-qa="start-missing"] reads Needs: Story key, Feature or flow and [data-qa="start-confirm"] is disabled.

requirements.text: Filling the required start fields enables Start
acceptance: Once both required fields hold a value, no element matches [data-qa="start-missing"] and [data-qa="start-confirm"] is enabled and reads Start run.

requirements.text: Dismiss closes the start card without starting a run
acceptance: Clicking [data-qa="start-dismiss"] removes the card: no element matches [data-qa="start-card"], and [data-qa="nav-runs"] lists the same number of runs as it did before the click.

requirements.text: The first checkpoint disables Back and offers Proceed
acceptance: At the first checkpoint [data-qa="decision-back"] is disabled, [data-qa="decision-proceed"] is enabled with the step's proceed label, and [data-qa="decision-edit"], [data-qa="decision-regenerate"] and [data-qa="decision-abort"] are present in the decision row.
